report.title: Rhombus 2.0 — 적대적 레드팀 감사
report.method: user-supplied critical source/code/workflow review, not full independent penetration or scientific reproduction

pr_281_final_ci: Phase 3 GitHub Synthetic Checkpoint Cross-Job Roundtrip

findings.claim: Public B3 HELD_OUT material identities and truth references are development-visible; existing blinding-integrity logic correctly rejects strong independent qualification.
findings.remediation: Treat all existing B3 held-out as diagnostic, design a new externally sealed blinded benchmark with separate steward, preregister protocol and source exclusion, prohibit identity/truth data in code, CI, chat, training context until lock.
findings.acceptance: Independent steward demonstrates no identity/truth retrieval before frozen predictions; locked predictions predate sealed truth release; fail-closed leakage test; contaminated legacy B3 never becomes final qualification.

findings.claim: Publisher-reported MACE-MPA-0 medium digest and MPTrj+sAlex families are not exact checkpoint-selected frame/preprocessing evidence.
findings.remediation: Independently hash exact model binary; obtain authoritative selected MPTrj and sAlex frame manifests, preprocessing and energy-label mapping; bind source SHA256 and verify exposures against blinded evaluation materials.
findings.acceptance: Immutable model/data/protocol hashes and selected-frame manifests independently audited; no exact training-membership or unseen qualification claims before evidence.

findings.claim: Two scoreable materials per POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, BORDERLINE role suffice only for minimum split feasibility, not precise statistical performance.
findings.remediation: Preregister unit of analysis at MATERIAL level, fixed acquisition/inclusion/exclusion, sample size and precision/power rationale, material-level confidence intervals, all negatives and failures included.
findings.acceptance: External held-out sample meets predeclared material-level criteria and reports uncertainty/failed runs; no performance or generalization PASS from current six small materials.

findings.claim: Branch marked protected but required-check enforcement cannot be authenticated using current GitHub integration (403); no rulesets listed by accessible API.
findings.remediation: Repository administrator confirms/enforces required checks by exact job name, up-to-date PR branches, PR-only merge, review approval and no admin bypass; separately attempt safe intentionally failing PR.
findings.acceptance: Administrator produces captured effective ruleset/protection evidence AND a failed-check dummy PR cannot merge, without actually merging it.

findings.claim: Kaggle local 50k chunks and 0117 GitHub synthetic two-job artifact roundtrip do NOT prove Kaggle crash-safe upload or resumable science.
findings.remediation: Develop source-shard contract, retrieve/store each independently completed chunk to authorized external store, hash+SQLite+source lineage check, kill/restart tests, no gaps or duplicate work.
findings.acceptance: Two separate authorized small real-source-bound shard jobs, external artifact retrieval, tamper rejection and deterministic interruption/resume/merge passes before full Kaggle dispatch.

findings.claim: Outgoing artifact scanner skips ZIP/GZ/ZST/SQLite content, so scan PASS does not imply confidentiality.
findings.remediation: Default-deny uninspected opaque files before export; add bounded ZIP/gzip/zstd/SQLite-aware scan or strict allowlist/sanitized manifest and archive-entry tests, protect decompression bombs and secrets.
findings.acceptance: Fake secrets nested in representative compressed/SQLite artifacts are detected or artifact upload blocked; output explicitly says uninspected opaque bytes are not cleared.

findings.claim: sAlex launch request has armed=true and launch_once=true without persistent unique consumed-run enforcement.
findings.remediation: Disarm existing approved request by policy, add per-request nonce/external durable consumed ledger and atomic duplicate denial; avoid re-dispatch by mere main push, require explicit fresh operator authorization.
findings.acceptance: Same launch request cannot result in a second Kaggle submit under replay/concurrency/retry; default false and log+ledger receipts persisted.

findings.claim: Two models may share training exposure or physical biases; short MD and 550K results alone do not validate room-temperature conductivity.
findings.remediation: Pre-register independent-source model comparisons, trajectory window/block adequacy, rare event/defect and temperature extrapolation boundaries; retain UNKNOWN/FAILED/NONDIFFUSIVE outcomes without dropping them.
findings.acceptance: Material-level failure accounting and transport validity review confirm outcome coverage; claimed evidence independence and temperature transfer audited; unresolved cases remain INDETERMINATE.

findings.claim: Standalone rudeus/mlip/p3_transport.py Arrhenius helper permits degenerate identical temperatures before polyfit.
findings.remediation: Require >=2 physically distinct temperatures, full-rank inverse-T design, finite bounded conditioning and degenerate CI handling; no SUPPORTED_BY_DATA on ill-conditioned data.
findings.acceptance: Adversarial [300,300], near-identical temperatures, collinear/ill-conditioned and finite/nonfinite cases fail closed; conventional valid cases retain behavior.

findings.claim: Nernst–Einstein helper uses int(charge_number) and silently truncates 1.9 to 1.
findings.remediation: Require strict signed nonzero integer charge (reject float, bool, string and nonfinite without coercion).
findings.acceptance: charge_number=1.9/True/'1'/0 explicitly rejected; +/- valid integer charge yields expected z-squared conductivity.

findings.claim: Python library minimum bounds, Kaggle floating installs and tag-based GitHub Actions leave environment drift possibilities.
findings.remediation: Inventory exact dependency locks and hashes, action commit SHAs, Kaggle runtime/container Python and OS, GPU precision/seed/model+dataset digest, compare independent reruns.
findings.acceptance: Output has verifiable complete run manifest and environment diff; no 'bitwise reproducible' claim without verified identical reruns.

milestones.deliverable: Blinded frozen predictions, external truth adjudication, uncertainty+failure report and independent rerun. No blanket PASS without evidence

operating_rules: Treat report findings as source-informed leads; distinguish verified source defects, existing mitigations, capability not yet proved, and admin access limitations.
Every finding needs a failing adversarial test before being promoted to RESOLVED; CI passing alone never qualifies scientific model claims.
Require exact-head Fast+Continuity+Wave2 on each PR, but until admin verifies rules these are developer merge policy not proven server enforcement.
Do not post new sealed evaluation identities/truths to a public repository, PR, CI output, AI developer context or source code before frozen predictions.
Never expand exposure, independent blind performance, autonomous execution, or MACE generalization on WBM/MPTrj source-only overlap or synthetic tests.
Large Kaggle/MPTrj computations require scoped independent resource approval and proven recovered checkpoint external lineage.
Preserve every material-level outcome including UNKNOWN, INDETERMINATE, FAILED and NONDIFFUSIVE and pre-register exclusion rules.
Legacy benchmark B3 remains visible for diagnostic regression, not independent blind qualification.

operator_tasks.task: Verify effective main protection/rulesets with privileged GitHub access; enforce required checks/reviews/admin no-bypass and demonstrate failing PR blocked
Generate truly sealed evaluation materials and truth outside public Rhombus and development-accessible channels until predictions are committed
Acquire checkpoint-selected frame/preprocessing/label provenance from model publisher and justify held-out power, uncertainty and negative-result policy
